question: Define partnership under the Indian Partnership Act, 1932 and explain its essential elements.

points.label: Definition
points.description: Partnership is the relation between persons who have agreed to share the profits of a business carried on by all or any of them acting for all.

points.label: Agreement and association of two or more persons
points.description: Partnership arises from an agreement (oral or written), not from status or operation of law, between at least two persons.

points.label: Business
points.description: The agreement must be to carry on a business, which includes every trade, occupation and profession.
points.basis: Indian Partnership Act, 1932, Section 2(b) and Section 4

points.label: Sharing of profits
points.description: The partners must agree to share the profits of the business; sharing of profits alone is not conclusive proof of partnership.

points.label: Mutual agency
points.description: The business must be carried on by all or any of them acting for all, so each partner is both an agent and a principal of the others; this is the true test of a partnership.
